summary: Red-phase tests and migration evidence were added, but the isolated environment has no Swift executable, so swift test --disable-sandbox could not run.

references.result: Red by design: asserts the missing generator/runtime dependencies, generator target, and vendored OpenAPI document.

Local URLProtocol stubs cover manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, and judgment upload; ranked-results remains an implementation gap described in docs/openapi-client-migration.md.
Requires the generated target and app migration before compile-time inspection is possible.
Records source-verified prose-contract deltas and the ranked-results endpoint gap.
